# Saurabh Lokhande — AI Engineer & Generative AI Specialist

AI Engineer building Agentic AI systems since 2022, RAG pipelines, and LLM-powered applications. Based in India. Open to AI engineering roles, freelance AI projects, and collaborations.

## Featured Projects

- [Hire Me OS 2.0](/project/hire-me-os) — Multi-tenant career SaaS: 6-block job evaluation with 10 scored dimensions and an A–F grade, Autopilot scheduler, AI resume tailor, and Chrome extension. Built with Next.js 16, Supabase, and Prisma.
- [Doc AI](/project/doc-ai) — Document intelligence with hybrid BM25 + vector RAG and cited answers. v2 engine evaluated on 4,584 pages: Recall@3 97.5%, MRR@10 0.867, retrieval p50 0.55 s (40-question synthetic set; technical report: https://github.com/saurabhmj11/Doc-AI-Enterprise-RAG-Chatbot/blob/main/TECHNICAL_REPORT.md).
- [Multi-Agent Research](/project/multi-agent-research) — LangGraph planner, researcher, verifier and writer agents (Python/FastAPI) running locally on Ollama.
- [DataOS](/project/dataos) — Browser-based simulation of an agentic data-analysis platform with Gemini-powered Q&A. MIT licensed.

## Core Capabilities

LLM Agents · RAG Systems · LangChain · LangGraph · OpenAI API · ChromaDB · BM25 · Hybrid Search · FastAPI · React · TypeScript · Python · Docker · PostgreSQL · Reciprocal Rank Fusion · Microsoft Presidio · Autonomous AI Workflows · Multi-Agent Orchestration
